title: cyathea subtropica
intro: Cyathea subtropica, commonly known as the 'Fern Tree', is a species of tree fern that belongs to the Cyathea genus. This plant is widely distributed in Australia and New Zealand and is known for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Cyathea subtropica include wound healing, antiseptic, and antifungal activities, which can be attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids. However, more research is needed to fully understand the extent of its health benefits and therapeutic actions.
